body.en:
Question B-003-021-003.

Why the correct answer is right: Before shielding is removed, the amplifier must be unable to turn on accidentally, preventing exposed RF energy and high voltage from becoming live.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Make sure that RF leakage filters are connected": Filters do not make an open amplifier safe if it can energize high-voltage or RF circuits while shielding is removed.
- sourceIndex 2: "Make sure the amplifier output connector is grounded": Grounding an output connector does not lock out the internal power supply or prevent accidental energizing.
- sourceIndex 3: "Make sure all RF screens are in place at the amplifier output connector": The hazard is created by removing shielding. Checking a screen at one connector does not make the exposed amplifier safe to energize.
